verdict.rationale: OCI's docs state that the Free Trial gives $300 of credits valid for up to 30 days, alongside Always Free offers that never expire and stay available after the trial ends. Community users confirm running Always Free ARM instances for years, though they report idle reclamation after 7 days and account bans; these are policy caveats, not a contradiction of the free tier existing. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of the specific Always Free resource quotas (the 4 vCPU/24 GiB and 10TB figures appear only in community posts), and documentation of the idle-reclamation and usage rules.

support.subject: As a founder, starting is free — an always-free tier and/or published startup credits with the limits and expiry spelled out

citations.quote: The Free Trial provides you with $300 of cloud credits that are valid for up to 30 days.
a set of Always Free offers that never expire
After your trial ends, your account remains active. There is no interruption to the availability of the Always Free Resources you have provisioned.
Oracle Cloud free tier offers a 4x vCPU / 24 GiB ARM Ampere VPS plus 10TB bandwidth included
